versions.changelog:
- Added skill homepage link for easier access to documentation.
- Usage section now shows support for inputting text from files with the `-f` option.

- Changed audio output file extension in usage examples from .mp3 to .wav.
- Updated all relevant command examples to use .wav for generated audio files.
- No functional or code changes; documentation update only.
- The ZAI_AUDIO_TOKEN environment variable is now marked as secret in installation metadata.

- Initial release of zai-tts skill for text-to-speech conversion using the GLM-TTS service.
- Provides the `uvx zai-tts` command to generate audio from text with customizable speed, volume, and voice selection.
- Requires configuration of `ZAI_AUDIO_USERID` and `ZAI_AUDIO_TOKEN` from audio.z.ai.
- Supports multiple pre-cloned voices and ability to list available voices.
- Offers clear instructions for installation and environment setup.
